description: A man in a white shirt and dark tie sits at a grey metal control panel with rows of switches, levers and dials, one hand reaching toward the switches and his face strained. A man in a grey lab coat stands behind him with a hand on his shoulder. The room is dark and plain, with a closed door, a single overhead light, and a tiled wall. The mood is tense and sombre, and the clothing and equipment look mid-twentieth century. No text, numbers or frame are visible, and the painting runs edge to edge.
